  Experience with MCP servers, agent orchestration, or retrieval systems 
  Experience driving adoption of a platform capability across multiple teams 
  Working Git proficiency

* Apply post\-training expertise (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) to connect observed failures to the data and training interventions that address them.
* Publish research findings in top\-tier AI conferences.

* Deep understanding of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and large\-scale model fine\-tuning.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Published research in areas of machine learning at major conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, etc.) and/or journals.
* Previous experience in a customer facing role.

**Job Description**
**The Role**
 As an L6 Data Scientist supporting Sales, Brand \& Dealer, you will lead the execution of one or more workstreams within an AI, machine learning, or data science product. You will build deep technical expertise under the guidance of the product’s lead scientist while actively contributing to product decisions, methodological direction, and the development of high\-impact solutions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead the execution of assigned AI, machine learning, or data science workstreams from methodology through delivery.
* Contribute to product decisions and help shape the ideation, design, and development of analytical methods and solutions.
* Develop high\-quality code that is methodologically sound, maintainable, scalable, and operationally robust.
* Explore and apply new methods, technologies, and approaches to expand the product’s technical capabilities.
* Deliver results on time while managing risks and maintaining methodological and operational quality.
* Partner cross\-functionally with data engineering, software delivery, product delivery teams, business units, and other stakeholders to drive product development and business outcomes.
* Translate complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, assumptions, and risks into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders and leaders.
* Present workstream progress, findings, and business impact to technical and business audiences.


**Your Skills And Abilities (Required Qualifications)**
* 3\+ years working in the field of advanced analytics, AI/ML and/or operations research initiatives, developing and integrating analytical methods into software products;
* Demonstrated use of innovative methodologies and approaches to solving business problems, resulting in meaningful business impact;
* Experience across multiple AI/ML and analytics domains (LLMs, forecasting, deep learning, operations research, prescriptive \& predictive methods, etc.);
* Expertise in Python and other cloud\-based data science platforms (Databricks preferred), and proficiency in SQL;
* Experience with generative AI tools and platforms such as Cursor, GitHub and/or Microsoft Copilot, Glean, Databricks Genie, etc.
* Strong presentation and communication skills; and
* M.S. or Ph.D. in operations research, engineering, computer science, applied statistics, economics, physics, or related field. Equivalent additional experience may substitute for advanced degree.


**What Can Give You a Competitive Advantage (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience contributing to AI, machine learning, or data science products from concept through production delivery.
* Experience influencing product decisions and shaping methodological direction.
* Breadth across modern data science methods, tools, and technologies, with a demonstrated interest in continuous technical growth.
* Experience building solutions that are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and operationally ready.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary teams, including data engineering, software engineering, product delivery, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to connect technical work to measurable business impact. Publications, conference talks, patents or other generated intellectual property, committed open\-source work, or other external technical recognition preferred.
* Experience presenting complex analytical results and technical tradeoffs to senior leaders and diverse audiences.

 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\) Networking team is looking for software engineers who have a passion for diving deep while also being able to see the big picture. We are re\-engineering our virtual networking control plane as part of Amazon’s initiative to get EC2 performance to be as close as possible to that of bare metal. This role would involve being part of the team that owns building, scaling, and maintaining high performance software to streamline the management of millions of Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) configurations.
   

  

 If you are a Software Engineer with a strong background coding in Linux, a passion for improving quality, solving challenging problems and curiosity about virtual networking, then this is your opportunity to own major deliverables and all aspects of the development cycle: scoping, design, implementation, and testing. You will be encouraged to exercise judgment in proactively determining and recommending the best features, designs, and support models based on business objectives, timelines, and resource constraints.
   

  

 What makes this team a great place to work? Our services underpin the fabric of the EC2 cloud. You have the opportunity to make a large impact and drive the road map for the Amazon cloud.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud services and features that power AWS's core infrastructure
* Collaborate with product managers and senior engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Write high\-quality, efficient code while adhering to AWS's architectural best practices
* Participate in code reviews to ensure quality, security, and performance standards
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across AWS services
* Implement automated testing frameworks to ensure reliability and performance
* Contribute to on\-call rotations to support production systems
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance
* Document system designs, APIs, and operational procedures
* Continuously evaluate and improve existing systems for performance, scalability, and cost\-efficiency
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends

 Our team actively supports new members through knowledge\-sharing and mentorship. With diverse experience levels, we provide one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough code reviews. * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

 The Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond.  Key job responsibilities

* Conduct applied research in novel generative AI techniques (e.g., fine\-tuning, RAG, agentic workflows) to optimize the shopper experience and drive performance across all aspects of the Sponsored Products and Brands business.

* 3\+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4\+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high\-performance computing


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

* Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field

* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Data Scientist to support ElevenLabs' offline media and strategic marketing bets: from OOH billboards to niche sponsorships and experimental brand campaigns. You'll build the frameworks that tell us whether a channel with no click to track is actually working, partnering closely with Marketing and the Growth Data team.
   

  

* Design and run measurement for offline / out\-of\-home campaigns: geo holdout tests, matched\-market tests, media mix modelling and incrementality studies.
* Partner directly with Marketing leadership on which niche channels, markets or formats to test next, and size the bet.
* Build models that combine offline spend data with digital and product signals into one coherent view of marketing effectiveness.
* Work alongside the Growth Data team's digital marketing data scientists to keep offline and online measurement consistent.


**Requirements**
 Demonstrated experience measuring marketing effectiveness, ideally including offline, brand or hard\-to\-track channels (OOH, TV, podcast, sponsorship, events).
   

  

* Strong SQL and Python, with experience in causal inference, media mix modelling or incrementality testing.
* Comfort designing measurement without a clean click\-level signal, and communicating uncertainty honestly.
* Strong stakeholder management with Marketing / Brand leadership, able to turn a strategic question into a testable plan.
* Structured thinker comfortable with ambiguity: this is a newer, less\-defined function.


**Bonus**
* Experience specifically with OOH, billboard or experiential campaign measurement.
* Experience with media mix modelling tools or frameworks (Robyn, Recast, LightweightMMM or similar).
* Experience partnering with brand or creative teams on niche or unconventional marketing bets.


 Location
   

  

 This role is remote\-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in CET / ET timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin or New York.

**The Team**
 The Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI\-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.
   

  

 Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start\-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product\-market fit. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation \& product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Are you energized by both winning the deal and delivering on it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE), you'll be the GTM \& Delivery engine for Signals, a priority product in the Converge for FSI portfolio. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and chaning market. You'll bring core consulting skills, financial services industry knowledge, and the ability to work with key stakeholders (product managers, technical / engineering teams, and Market Makers) to qualify product fit, pitch / demo products to clients, shape \& commercialize opportunities, and deliver work by managing scope, timeline, and client outcomes. You'll be expected to be equally comfortable pitching and demoing to a C\-suite leader as you are working with product / engineering teams to deliver on a proof of concept.
   

  

 As the pFDE, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, vision, and operations of the FDE function for the Signals product. You will drive commercial success by defining commercialization models, working with internal teams to enable licensing, and making it easier for Market Makers to sell products to clients. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles.
   

  

 Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between winning new product business and delivering on it once sold. You will:
   

  

**Pre\-Sale:**
* Build and maintain relationships with market makers, buyer decision\-makers, and Deloitte account teams to identify and shape product opportunities
* Prepare and deliver pitches and product demos to client executives (including C\-suite), translating Signals for FSI product value into a clear business case
* Develop go\-to\-market materials \- pitch decks, demo scripts, one\-pagers, case studies \- that Sales and Product teams can reuse across engagements
* Partner with Market Makers and Product Managers to scope, price, and staff delivery engagements (incl. building scoping documents, pricing models, and commercial agreements)
* Enable commercialization of products, create standardized license agreements, and be an advisor to Market Makers less familiar with taking Products to market


**Post\-Sale:**
* Lead delivery of scoped proofs of concept (POCs) and in\-market testing, working hands\-in\-hand with engineering and data science teams to deliver the product to the client to drive outcomes for their business
* Serve as the client's primary point of contact post\-sale, managing scope, timeline, and outcomes, and escalating/resolving issues that put delivery at risk
* Translate client requirements and product gaps back to Product Managers to inform the product feature backlog, distinguishing custom delivery needs from core product enhancements
* Build, maintain, and scale reusable delivery assets, demo patterns, and implementation playbooks that accelerate the sales and deployment cycle for future engagements
* Provide a continuous feedback loop between clients and the product team, and support knowledge transfer to delivery teams
* Operate within defined engagement guardrails \- scoped, time\-boxed, and outcome\-oriented \- to protect capacity and ensure clean handoffs at the end of each deployment/delivery


 The successful candidate would possess these skills:
   

  

* Comfortable moving fluidly between client\-facing selling conversations and hands\-on delivery oversight, without needing to write the underlying code
* Strong executive presence and communicator, able to translate technical product capability into a business case for client executives and internal stakeholders alike
* Able to work effectively alongside engineering and technical delivery teams \- understanding enough of the technical picture to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot delivery without being the hands\-on engineer or data scientist
* Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry sufficient to speak credibly to industry\-specific client problems across banking, insurance, and investment management
* Ability to deliver work within scope / timelines and take an "outcomes" mindset to ensure client receives maximum value
* Comfortable working through hard, ambiguous problems that require critical thinking, resourcefulness, and grit
* Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client\-relevant use cases
* Deep understanding of customer data science, segmentation, and behavioral insights that can be leveraged for sales and marketing across consumer and business customers
* Knowledge and experience across the marketing, sales and distribution of financial services products and services
* Deep understanding of customer data platforms, use of market research survey data and data science modeling to project insights and findings to larger populations
* Understanding of data transfer protocols \- SFTP, Cloud Bucket to Bucket transfers, Clean Rooms and CRMs, and Martech Customer Data Platforms
* Awareness and depth of knowledge of 1 st and 3 rd party data uses to drive marketing and sales.
* Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
* Self\-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
* Natural curiosity and a bias for building \- you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one


**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Data Science or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
* 3\+ years of client\-facing management or technology consulting / professional services experience, including leading delivery of technology\-enabled engagements
* 2\+ years of experience within, or delivering consulting/technology engagements to, the financial services industry
* Demonstrated experience working alongside engineering, data science, or technical delivery teams to scope, sequence, and troubleshoot data / technology implementations, without requiring hands\-on coding
* Demonstrated experience contributing to sales and business development activities (e.g., client pitches, proposals, demos) in addition to delivery
* Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience selling and/or delivering licensable software/data products or productized services, as distinct from custom SOW\-based or traditional consulting delivery
* Prior experience in a startup, high\-growth SaaS or data/insights environment
* Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations

Full Stack Engineer (AI\-Native) — Earnie
 
**Company:** 

  Earnie 
 
**Location:** 

  Hybrid — Bloomfield, Michigan area preferred 
 
**Employment type:** 

  Full\-time
 




**Compensation:** 

  $4,000 – $7,000 per month \+ bonus and profit sharing
 




  




 About Earnie
 

 Earnie is the AI sales assistant and gamification platform for commission\-based sales teams. It connects to the CRM, reads live production data, and acts on it within guardrails the manager sets: Battles, Challenges, a Live Scoreboard, Goals, an AI Coach, and a rewards economy reps actually care about.
 





 The manager is the hero. Earnie is the system that carries what one manager can't carry alone. We move fast and we expect speed and quality at the same time. Mistakes are part of moving fast — we just own them, fix them quickly, and don't make the same one twice. The engineer we hire will shape the product as much as build it.
 




  




 The role
 

 We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer who builds with AI as a default, not an experiment. You'll own features end to end: the data model, the API, the UI, the mobile release, and the AI logic that makes Earnie feel like a coach instead of a dashboard.
 





 This is not a ticket\-taking seat. You'll work directly with the founders, talk to customers when it helps, and decide how things get built. Some weeks you're shipping a real\-time scoreboard. Others you're wiring a CRM integration, tuning an AI prompt chain, or pushing a build through TestFlight.
 




  




 What you'll do
 * **Build the core product.** 
  Ship web features in Next.js, TypeScript, and Vercel — scoreboards, Battles, Challenges, Goals, and manager views.
* **Own the backend.** 
  Design schemas, auth, storage, and edge functions in Supabase, including the ledger behind Earnie's coin and rewards economy.
* **Make it real\-time.** 
  Build live leaderboards, notifications, and event\-driven updates that react the moment a rep closes a deal.
* **Connect to where sales happens.** 
  Build and maintain integrations with Salesforce and other CRMs, plus Slack and Microsoft Teams.
* **Ship AI into the product.** 
  Build the AI Coach, forecasting, and the read → diagnose → recommend → execute loop using LLM APIs, with guardrails managers can trust.
* **Ship mobile.** 
  Take iOS and Android builds through App Store Connect, TestFlight, and Google Play Console.
* **Build AI\-first.** 
  Use Claude Code, Cursor, and agents daily to plan, write, test, and review code faster.
* **Shape what we build.** 
  Turn founder ideas and customer feedback into specs, push back when something won't work, and propose better ideas.



  




 What we're looking forTechnical depth
 * Production experience with Next.js and TypeScript
* Comfort with Vercel deployments and serverless functions
* Working knowledge of Supabase: Postgres, auth, row\-level security, storage, edge functions, realtime
* Experience shipping iOS apps through App Store Connect and TestFlight; Google Play a plus
* Experience with third\-party APIs, webhooks, and OAuth integrations
* Full\-stack range, from UI polish to API design to data modeling



  




 AI\-native building
 * You use Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools every day, not occasionally
* You've built features on top of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar), not just used AI to write code
* You write sharp prompts, break work into tasks an agent can run, and review AI output critically
* You know when to lean on AI and when to slow down and write it yourself



  




 How you work
 * You learn fast and pick up new domains without hand\-holding
* You're self\-directed and calm with ambiguity
* You communicate clearly with non\-technical founders, managers, and customers
* You care about the end user — the rep checking the scoreboard and the manager running the team
* You ship fast without getting sloppy: work goes out in days, not weeks, and it's tested and solid when it does
* You're not afraid to break things. When something goes wrong, you say so early, fix it fast, and learn from it



  




 Nice to have
 * React Native or Flutter for cross\-platform mobile
* Salesforce API experience (REST, Bulk, Platform Events)
* Background in gamification, loyalty, rewards, or payments systems
* Experience with AI agents, tool use, RAG, or evals
* Startup experience as an early engineer
* Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Firebase
* Exposure to sales, retail, mortgage, or insurance teams
* Open\-source contributions



  




 Why Earnie
 * **Real ownership.** 
  You'll build core systems, not polish someone else's. Your decisions show up in the product within days.
* **AI at the center.** 
  AI is the product, not a side feature. You'll build agents that read data, make calls, and take action.
* **Problems with range.** 
  Real\-time systems, CRM integrations, a rewards economy, mobile, and applied AI — all in one role.
* **Direct line to the founders.** 
  No layers. Ideas get heard and shipped fast.
* **Work people feel.** 
  Earnie helps commission\-based teams hit goals and earn more. You'll see the impact on real teams.

 We're partnered with a mission\-driven healthcare technology company working at the intersection of clinical data and AI. **About Us**

That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.
   

  

 Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.
   

  

 We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.
   

  

 We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. Who We Are
   

  

 Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future.
   

  

 We’ve made significant progress toward building models that can control many different robots across a wide range of tasks. Now, we’re building the platform that will make those models accessible to the broader world.
   

  

 As an API Product Engineer, you’ll build the product surface that allows other companies to use Pi’s models much like developers use an LLM API today: bring their own data, fine\-tune models, evaluate them, and run low\-latency inference in their own environments.
   

  

 You’ll own this experience end to end, turning capabilities that today require close collaboration with our team into a platform that can eventually support thousands—and ultimately millions—of robots.
   

  

 The Team
   

  

 Software Engineering at Pi builds the systems that scale research breakthroughs into reliable products in the physical world.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of our AI, infrastructure, and external partners. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to turn rapidly evolving model capabilities into APIs and tools that external users, from hobbyists to large organizations, can actually build on.
   

  

 Today, onboarding a new partner to Pi can involve significant hands\-on work. The goal is to make that increasingly unnecessary: partners should be able to bring us data, fine\-tune a model, evaluate it, and run inference through a product that is intuitive, reliable, and built to scale.
   

  

 In This Role You Will
   

  

 This is a software and systems role first. Robotics experience is not required, and we’re particularly excited about people who have built developer platforms, model APIs, or infrastructure products outside of robotics.
   

  

* Build Pi’s model API end to end, including data ingestion, fine\-tuning, evaluation, low\-latency remote inference, partner\-facing tools, and deployment integrations.
* Design systems that can scale from a small number of deeply integrated partners to thousands of organizations and potentially millions of robots.
* Architect reliable, multi\-tenant infrastructure around rate limiting, isolation, backpressure, versioning, observability, and SLOs.
* Turn partner data into a first\-class product experience, from initial upload through validation, processing, fine\-tuning, and evaluation.
* Build and operate low\-latency inference systems that allow Pi models to control robots running in real\-world environments.
* Work closely with researchers to turn new model capabilities into stable, usable product surfaces.
* Learn from how partners use the platform and turn recurring friction into better APIs, tooling, documentation, and abstractions.
* Write high\-quality production code that integrates deeply with Pi’s existing infrastructure.
* Define what the developer platform for general\-purpose robotics should look like. There is no established playbook for this yet.


 What We Hope You'll Bring
   

  

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.
* Deep backend and systems experience across APIs, services, databases, caching, distributed systems, and infrastructure.
* Experience building and scaling developer platforms. We’re especially interested in people who have shipped platforms for model fine\-tuning, inference, or other compute\-intensive workloads.
* An understanding of the problems that emerge as systems scale: reliability, latency, multi\-tenancy, versioning, observability, and operational complexity.
* Enough familiarity with machine learning systems to deploy, serve, and debug models in production. You do not need to be an ML researcher.
* Strong Python skills and the ability to work comfortably across infrastructure and product boundaries.
* A high degree of ownership. You’re comfortable taking an ambiguous problem, building the first version end to end, and then designing the system so it no longer depends on you.


 Bonus Points If You Have
   

  

* Experience building low\-latency or real\-time systems, including streaming, inference transport, WebSockets, QUIC, or similar technologies.
* Experience building model\-serving, inference, fine\-tuning, or developer\-platform infrastructure.
* Experience at an early\-stage infrastructure, AI, robotics, or autonomous systems company.
* Familiarity with our stack: Python, Postgres, ClickHouse, GCP, Kubernetes, Modal, React, and TypeScript.
* Experience with security, authentication, authorization, or multi\-tenant infrastructure.


 What This Role Is Not
   

  

* This is not a Customer Success role. You won’t own ongoing partner support or change management inside customer organizations.
* This is not a Partner Roboticist or Applied Research role. You won’t be responsible for training policies for individual partners or debugging robots on site.
* This is not a traditional ML infrastructure role focused primarily on training systems, compilers, or accelerator scheduling. You’ll work closely with those systems, but your focus is the product and platform through which the outside world uses Pi’s models.

**OnCore Data Analyst – Remote Work Arrangement**
 The Stanford Cancer Institute (SCI) was re\-designated as a Comprehensive Cancer center by the NCI in early 2022, and is a prominent, dynamic, growing, and complex Institute within the Stanford University School of Medicine. The SCI actively works to build synergies and collaborations among faculty with cancer\-relevant expertise from four Schools and over 30 departments across Stanford University.
   

  

 SCI is seeking a Data Analyst 3 to perform complex technical work associated with a wide variety of analytical data and fulfill customized and/or complex, single, and multi\-data sources’ information requests. Identify new data sources and approaches. Data Analyst 3 will independently manage and analyze large volumes of information, typically technical or scientific, with minimal supervision. This position will focus on supporting oncological clinical research, production systems, and ongoing maintenance while maintaining close collaborations with internal and external stakeholders. The OnCore Data Analyst 3 will be part of a team responsible for collecting and quality\-assuring NCI\-required data and will provide ongoing support to users throughout the Cancer Institute and the School of Medicine. He/She will generate data tables using SQL queries in Snowflake for data extraction and utilize OnCore, REDCap, and Tableau for presentations, publications, and posters. In addition, the Data Analyst will prepare customized reports about Stanford oncological clinical trials and their accrual for the NCI, SCI Administration, and Principal Investigators.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director of Clinical Research Services, the OnCore Data Analyst 3 will support clinical cancer research. The Director will be conversant with the Institute's goals, mission, and priorities and will use this knowledge to conduct impactful clinical research focused on high\-quality and efficiency. We are seeking candidates with excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. Candidates must be eager to take on challenges with a high degree of professionalism, initiative, and flexibility. Responsibilities include working with the research team, clinical staff, and Stanford Health Care departments to support safe and compliant clinical research.
   

  

**Desired Qualifications**
* Strong technical background in SQL, Snowflake, data modeling, and data preparation.
* Experience working in Tableau Desktop and REDCap.
* Working knowledge of clinical trials
* Ability to analyze complex systems and workflows.
* Experience with electronic medical records system such as Epic
* Proficiency with NCI’s Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG).
* Excellent problem solving, analytical, and project management skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Takes initiative and tackles challenges with enthusiasm.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**
* Constantly perform desk\-based computer tasks.

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or a Master's Degree.

**━ About the Role** 




 We are looking for an ML Engineer to own model development on a federal data and AI program: self\-supervised representation learning over tabular and temporal administrative data, language\-model\-based information extraction from unstructured records, supervised classification on learned embeddings, and model explainability. The work is performed against large linked datasets inside an access\-restricted analytic environment with approved tooling, no external connectivity, and CPU\-only compute.
 



 This is a modeling role, not a pipeline role. You will be accountable for architecture selection, training, calibration and validation of the models the program depends on, and for the quantitative judgment behind each of those decisions. Data engineering is part of the job; it is not the center of it.
 



**━ What You Will Do** 




**Representation Learning** 



* Design and train self\-supervised tabular transformers (SAINT, TabTransformer, FT\-Transformer) and temporal sequence models over longitudinal event data, with the outcome label withheld during pretraining.
* Select pretraining objectives, execute pilot runs, and validate embedding quality before committing to full\-scale training.
* Benchmark candidate architectures against gradient\-boosted baselines and document comparative results.



  





**Language Model Extraction** 



* Deploy locally hosted open\-weight language models for structured information extraction from unstructured text, including prompt design, constrained output schemas and post\-processing.
* Quantize and tune models for CPU\-only inference at volume without unacceptable degradation in extraction accuracy.
* Implement the dual\-coding evaluation protocol — stratified sampling, independent human coding, field\-level agreement measurement — and report accuracy before volume extraction.



  





**Supervised Modeling and Calibration** 



* Train gradient\-boosted classifiers (LightGBM, XGBoost) on learned embeddings under severe class imbalance.
* Perform threshold calibration on the validation partition with the cost of each error type made explicit, and report calibration curves alongside discrimination metrics.
* Detect and prevent leakage across temporal splits and across linked record sources.



  





**Explainability** 



* Generate additive feature attributions (SHAP) at the individual\-prediction level and aggregate them across cohorts and subgroups.
* Verify that attributions are stable across model retrains and consistent with domain expectations.



  





**Supporting Data Work** 



* Maintain the feature and inference pipelines the models depend on (Spark, Parquet, Python), and version every dataset, model and experiment in MLflow so reported results regenerate.



  





**━ Mathematical Foundation** 




 This is a modeling position and we weight mathematical grounding heavily. Applied fluency is expected in the following; the interview will test it.
 



**Area** 




**Expected depth** 




  





**Probability and statistical inference:** 
 Estimators, bias and variance, sampling distributions; correct interpretation of confidence intervals and calibration curves
 



**Linear algebra and optimization:** 
 Gradient\-based optimization, regularization, convexity and its failure in deep networks; attention understood as matrix operations
 



**Information theory:** 
 Cross\-entropy, KL divergence, and the loss functions behind self\-supervised and contrastive objectives
 



**Evaluation theory:** 
 Discrimination versus calibration; ROC and precision\-recall behavior under class imbalance; threshold selection by expected cost
 



**Causal reasoning:** 
 Confounding and leakage; recognizing when a feature encodes the outcome or a downstream consequence of it
 



  





**━ Technical Stack** 




**Layer** 




**Tools** 




  





**Tabular representation learning:** 
 SAINT, TabTransformer, FT\-Transformer; self\-supervised pretraining objectives (masked\-feature reconstruction, contrastive)
 



**Temporal and sequence modeling:** 
 Transformer encoders over ordered event sequences (BEHRT\-style), temporal convolutional networks
 



**Language models:** 
 Open\-weight instruction\-tuned models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen families) hosted locally; quantized CPU inference via llama.cpp or equivalent
 



**Supervised learning:** 
 LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost; scikit\-learn
 



**Deep learning framework:** 
 PyTorch
 



**Explainability:** 
 SHAP (TreeSHAP, KernelSHAP), integrated gradients
 



**Data and MLOps:** 
 Spark, Parquet, pandas, NumPy; MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning
 



**Environment:** 
 Cloud\-hosted, access\-restricted analytic environments
 



  





**━ What We're Looking For** 



* 3\+ years training and deploying machine learning models, with end\-to\-end ownership of at least one system from raw data to validated result.
* Hands\-on experience training transformer architectures in PyTorch, including at least one self\-supervised or contrastive objective on non\-text data.
* Experience deploying open\-weight language models for structured extraction, with accuracy measured against a labeled reference set.
* Demonstrated competence in calibration, class imbalance and leakage prevention on real observational data.
* Experience with gradient\-boosted methods (LightGBM, XGBoost or CatBoost) and with SHAP\-based explainability.
* Expert Python with NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn and PyTorch; strong SQL; Spark for large\-scale feature engineering.
* Master's degree in mathematics, statistics or applied mathematics with a data science concentration is preferred. Computer science or other quantitative degrees are considered where the transcript and work record demonstrate equivalent mathematical depth.



  





**━ Bonus Points** 



* Published or open\-source work on tabular deep learning, sequence modeling over event data, or LLM evaluation.
* Model quantization and CPU\-inference optimization at scale.
* Healthcare claims or other administrative data, including diagnosis and procedure coding systems.
* Fairness and subgroup evaluation methods in applied settings.
* Experience in FedRAMP, HIPAA or other access\-restricted environments; active or prior federal Public Trust determination.



  





**Core Competencies** 




**Competency: What It Looks Like Here** 




  





**Architecture Judgment:** 
 Selects and justifies model architecture against a benchmarked baseline.
 



**Self\-Supervised Modeling:** 
 Pretrains tabular and temporal transformers with the label withheld.
 



**Extraction Validation:** 
 Measures model\-versus\-human agreement before extracting at volume.
 



**Calibration Discipline:** 
 Reports calibration with discrimination and sets thresholds by cost.
 



**Mathematical Grounding:** 
 Explains why a method works, not only how to invoke it.
 



**Constrained Engineering:** 
 Delivers CPU\-only inference inside an approved\-library environment.
 



**Reproducibility:** 
 Every reported result regenerates from a recorded MLflow run.

 Interview Process
   

  

 Our goal with the interview process is to balance speed with giving both parties opportunities to assess whether there is a strong mutual fit. We will ask you questions, but we want you to ask us questions! Our technical interviews focus on how you design systems because we believe this is the best way for us to see how you work and for you to see how we collaborate. We don’t ask you to write code to solve technical brainteasers that don’t appear in your day to day job.
   

  

* Recruiter Screen \[30m]: Introductory call with our recruiting team to get to know each other and see if the role could be a good mutual fit.
* System Design Screen \[45m]: Designing a data processing feature end\-to\-end.
* Hiring Manager Interview \[30m]: Chat with hiring manager about past experiences and future operating preferences to assess fit on company values and operating principles.
* System Design Interview \[90m]: Work with the interviewer to architect a system at a conceptual level. The problem will be at a pretty high level \- and have both product and customer requirements as well as technical.

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to own solution design and implementation for our Identity Resolution (IDR) product. This role is a blend of data analytics and data engineering, and is an opportunity to work directly with data, marketing, and executive teams at household\-name companies. You'll spend time working with the customer to learn about their data architecture, reason about how Hightouch can accomplish their goals, set up deployments, and debug issues.
   

  

 This role is hands on and technical. You’ll become intimately familiar with our customers’ data and business goals. This expertise frequently leads to us advising executives at Fortune 500 companies on their long term data strategy. You'll spend time helping customers decide how their global identity spines should be configured, you'll set up implementations for them, and you'll debug inevitable issues with real data. You'll work closely with Sales Engineering on pre\-sales deals and with Customer Support Engineering and Technical Account Management on post\-sales implementations—serving as the subject matter expert for data engineering and analytics across the customer lifecycle.
   

  

 You'll work with coding agents as a default: the SQL, schema spelunking, and internal tooling in this role gets built with agents \- and you’ll help grow our repository of skills and best practices so we all get faster.
   

  

**About Hightouch Identity Resolution (IDR)**
 Imagine you're a sprawling enterprise business with 20\+ brands. Each brand collects different data elements from each of their customers and joins using different identifiers. Hightouch IDR can look across the customer data stored in each brand and provide a golden source of truth using all the available data, while obeying any regulatory restrictions that prevent data sharing. The product is highly configurable, and so no two customer data architectures are the same.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Solution Architecture \& Implementation Consulting**
* Work backwards from end goals: Customers ultimately don't care about IDR itself, but about the use cases that a good identity spine powers. You’ll pair with an architect to work backwards from the customer’s use cases to a set of IDR rules and a data model that enables those use cases
* Assess fit and feasibility: During pre\-sales, understand the customer’s data landscape and maturity, assessing how much work will be needed to get their data ready for IDR. Understand the rules of any current solutions (e.g., Reltio, Amperity, Segment, MDM tools) and identify, flag, and create workarounds for any gaps.


**Technical Support \& Debugging**
* Debug customer issues end\-to\-end: Investigate perceived issues and discrepancies in identity such as missing datapoints and over\-merging scenarios. Most debugging involves writing SQL against customer warehouses and reading server logs.
* Explain IDR behavior to customers: Help customers understand how warehouse\-native identity resolution works and detailed nuances of how it processes data incrementally or how to utilize its outcome tables.
* Surface product gaps: When you see the same issue repeatedly (e.g., no retroactive data removal, insufficient observability into profile changes, inability to reset incremental processing watermarks), flag and advocate for fixes.


**What We're Looking For**
* You direct agents, you don't just prompt them. You'll point them at warehouses with undocumented tables and no reliable dictionary, and you'll be the last judgment before what they build ships to millions of people. You reach for an agent before a blank editor, but you scrutinize every line before it goes out.
* SQL Fluency: Anyone can generate a thousand lines of SQL now. You're hired because you can read them and find the join that's wrong. Fluent in Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery, with query performance and warehouse cost as things you think about unprompted.
* Systems thinking: You can reason about how identity graphs behave at scale, understand trade\-offs between different architecture choices, and anticipate downstream consequences of design decisions.
* Consultative communication: You can run a discovery call, ask the right questions to understand requirements, and explain technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Systematic debugging mindset: You naturally form hypotheses, test them, and document findings. When you see "missing data," you think through timestamps, model definitions, and PK validity before jumping to conclusions.
* 2\-4 years in an analytics engineering, solutions engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, or implementation role—ideally at a data infrastructure, CDP, or B2B SaaS company.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with identity resolution, MDM, or CDP products (Segment, Amperity, Reltio, LiveRamp)
* Familiarity with graph data structures and entity resolution algorithms
* Experience with probabilistic matching or ML\-based identity systems
* Background in data engineering or analytics engineering
* Comfort with customer\-facing presentations and on\-site meetings


**Compensation**
 The salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $225,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote\-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity.
